paletteGenerateDialog.title: Generate Palette
paletteGenerateDialog.body0: Generate a palette in the Oklab color space, with steadily increasing perceived lightness. Use the sliders to adjust the green–red and blue–yellow balance of the colors.
paletteGenerateDialog.body1: However, since there are many more robust palette generators available, you may prefer using the import tool instead.

paletteImportDialog.title: Import Palette
paletteImportDialog.body: Import a custom palette by entering hex color values, one per line. You must provide at least two colors for a valid palette.
paletteImportDialog.hint:
Enter a list of hex values, one per line, e.g.:
#000000
#555555
#AAAAAA
#FFFFFF
